Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate dual-key provisioning, strict signer, and authenticated encrypted-package round trip
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: e769c065aac28f61ab88098fe16e9b5ed15aee78
Scope: Windows x64 restore, app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, signing positive/negative tests, AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP package encryption/decryption round trip, tampered ciphertext rejection, and updater transaction tests.
Security: throwaway ephemeral keys only. No owner private keys or credentials are used. No plaintext package, source archive, production key, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded. Optional ciphertext upload remains skipped until the owner public encryption key is configured.
